newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-S.EASTERNS BEAT W.TRANSVAAL 23-21.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-S.EASTERNS BEAT W.TRANSVAAL 23-21.

text.p: South-Eastern Transvaal, despite some sketchy place kicking, beat Western Transvaal 23-21 (halftime 8-9) in their Currie Cup rugby match at the Jan van Riebeck stadium on Saturday.
Although their kickers missed seven attempts out of nine, South-Easterns outscored their opponents by three tries to two in a game characterised by errors and poor handling.
Western Transvaal, bottom of the section A table, have won just one match in 11 outings while South-Easterns remain on course for an away quarter-final against Northern Transvaal.
South-Eastern Transvaal - Tries: Johan Visagie, Tobie Oosthuizen, Hakkies Swart. Conversion: Clive Terblanche. Penalty: Terblanche. Drop goal: Dan van Zyl.
Western Transvaal - Tries: Charl Bensch, Ricardo Erasmus. Conversion: Dewald Basson. Penalties: Basson (3).
